Despite facing cultural differences and other obstacles, their love perseveres as they strive to be together.

When they fail to hear from him for months Sukhilal offers to help as long as Laxmi becomes intimate with him, but when she refuses he decides to repossess their home and belongings as repayment for the loan.

She tried to commit suicide What happened of Rangilee ? programme.title: Woh Khaas
programme.desc: A business tycoon bored with his monotonous work-life escapes from his corporate setup for a day and ends up meeting a girl, who like a dream changes him upside down in a real ‘Filmy Manner’. Woh Khaas is a jazzy tribute to Bollywood romances that tries to combine the reality of love and the flamboyance of Indian cinema in an entertaining and enriching way.

programme.title: Trp
programme.desc: A victims father tries to get justice for his daughter despite the failed situation system in place.

programme.title: Uljhe Ho Kyun
programme.desc: Fitness influencer Abhay’s quirky habit of messaging his first likes leads him to Srishti, a corporate workaholic. As sparks fly, their contrasting worlds collide in a playful yet unpredictable romance. Will their chemistry sizzle or turn to ashes? A fun, fiery take on modern love.

programme.title: Writer
programme.desc: A quiet evening between a writer and his wife unravels into a surreal exploration of love, memory, and hidden truths. As reality shifts, so do the stories they’ve been telling themselves—and each other.

programme.title: The Decision
programme.desc: The Struggle of a Female Actress in the Film Industry: A young woman faces difficulties when working with a demanding director who creates a stressful environment. She expresses her concerns to the producer, but he reacts angrily and uses harsh language toward her. Will the actress decide to find a way to work together or stand up for herself?

programme.title: Humraz
programme.desc: This is the story of a couple who tried to raise their voice against the undesirable practice of one community. Hamraz is a witness to the hero playing Ravanahatha and the incidents that happened to him... Sometimes the image that looks white is also black... Humraz is a story full of mysteries... The curtain will soon fall on all the secrets and the real story will come out in front of everyone..

programme.title: Swad Anusar
programme.desc: A rich businessman loses his memory after a blow to the head but returns home alive after being thought dead. His family doesn't believe him and he realizes they may have conspired to kill him. He dies after eating poisoned food his wife prepared. His family admits their plot, but he will return with greater vengeance.

programme.title: The Footage
programme.desc: A spy dies in an elevator leaving a message on the CCTV footage. A lip-reader is called to find out what he said

programme.title: Two Strangers
programme.desc: This narrative revolves around a man with a scientific background, unwaveringly devoted to science and sceptical of miracles. He’s dealing with a mysterious health condition, leaving every doctor surprised. It’s like a puzzle and everyone around him is clueless about it. In a surprising twist, destiny intervenes to miraculously resolve his health issue, and he remains oblivious to this extraordinary turn of events, adding a layer of intrigue to the unfolding narrative.

programme.title: The Unsent Letter
programme.desc: Nidhi is haunted by her past; she's caged in it when suddenly she gets interrupted by a waiter asking for her order. After she pulls herself together, she realizes that the waiter had called her by her name. Nidhi finds out that the waiter is a man from her past. She is now left with a choice to face her nightmare and finally let go of everything that has haunted her till now or to continue living her life in a cage.

programme.title: The Please Book
programme.desc: Dora is a small girl from a rich family who lives with her father, a busy businessman. Due to his busy schedule, he is unable to spend quality time with her. Dora is very lonely and she does not have any friends. Her loneliness ends when one day she finds an old diary with “The Please Book” written on its cover. Soon she discovers it’s not an ordinary diary but a magical book. She believes that whatever you write in The Please Book, comes true.

programme.title: Yaantrik
programme.desc: Siddharth is a novelist. He is known for his different types of writing patterns. He always talks to his soul for some creative suggestions. Now he wants to write about a character called "Yaantrik". Siddharth wants to write a book on Yaantrik but this time as an experiment he wants to become a Yaantrik and then write a book. He will follow the routine of Yaantrik. His inner soul is not convinced with this idea. After being blocked in his own idea how his inner soul helped him out is the film.

programme.title: Tohfa
programme.desc: A gentleman bestowed upon his cherished wife an incredibly valuable and heartwarming present, yet fate had a different plan in store for their journey.

programme.title: Vansh
programme.desc: Dive into the powerful narrative of Vansh, a heartfelt short film from Vidyarthi Studios & Pocket Films, that explores the societal pressures surrounding gender expectations. This gripping tale follows a father's fierce desire for a son over his beloved daughter, shedding light on deep-seated beliefs and cultural traditions. As he grapples with his emotions, this poignant story opens a discussion about love, acceptance, and true parenthood. Don’t miss this eye-opening film that promises to challenge perceptions and evoke empathy.

programme.title: Love Range
programme.desc: In the bustling metro city of Mumbai, Ayush and Roohi's lives are turned upside down by the COVID-19 pandemic. When Ayush loses his job, Roohi decides to start a tiffin service to support the family, but Raj's traditional views and wounded ego create tension as he struggles with the idea of his wife being the breadwinner.

programme.title: Suta
programme.desc: Suta (The Daughter) is the story of a bold and smart daughter who fights for the sacrifices of her mother which went unnoticed in the family. She emerges victorious and sees that her mother gains back her confidence.

programme.title: Catharsis
programme.desc: A poignant journey of a man forced onto a path of self-discovery, exploring the depths of the human mind and spirit.

programme.title: Threes A Couple
programme.desc: 3 Lives Change after they cross each other's path on one auspicious night.

programme.title: Tithlee
programme.desc: Yamini, newly married, is getting ready to meet her mother-in-law, Reema's, friends and family. Reema suggests that Yamini should appear more presentable at the party and implies a preference for fair skin. Both Yamini and Reema's son, Ankush, want to challenge this prejudice, but they have different approaches.

programme.title: Kahwa
programme.desc: Set in July 2016, in the kashmir valley, post the encounter of militant Burhan Wadi, a period that had resulted in the loss of almost 70 lives and injured over 11000 people. A young CRPF official called Surkhab is sent to kashmir as a part of his very first posting along with a few other officers in the very first week of this curfew. Although he so posted in a small base where the clashes were not seen, yet he senses a feeling of fear and tense throughout. Surkhab who is very proud & committed army officer and at the same time mesmerised by the beauty of the valley and often wonders why a place so beautiful feels like a war zone. He arrives in the area and is assigned to maintain peace during the volatile period. He is determined to do his job with utmost sincerity and discipline. During one of his rounds, Surkhab meets Shaukhat, a tea seller, who is initially reluctant to interact with him due to the ongoing tensions. However, Surkhab insists on having a cup of tea with him, and slowly, they start talking about their lives and experiences. Shaukat has a grandson who loves to play cricket but is snatched the freedom of doing so due to the curfew. He gets together with some of his adult friends and they often secretly play gully cricket. As the curfew continues, Surkhab and Shaukat's bond grows stronger, and they discuss the unrest in the neighborhood, their families, and their dreams for a peaceful future. Despite their initial differences, Surkhab and Shaukhat find a common ground of acceptance and understanding over their shared cups of tea.However, this new found equation is put to the test when an unexpected event takes place, forcing them to confront their beliefs and loyalties. Kahwa is a story of how two individuals from vastly different backgrounds and ideologies can come together and form a bond of acceptance and empathy, even in the face of adversity.

programme.title: Vishaad
programme.desc: When a weary inspector is drawn to a reclusive scientist’s house on the edge of a quiet town, his investigation takes an unexpected turn. What begins as a routine inquiry slowly unfolds into an encounter with memory itself where loss finds an intangible resonance, and silence begins to speak. Vishaad is a lyrical meditation on grief, time, and the fragile human desire to regurgitate all that the heart has tried to bury.

programme.title: The Last Date
programme.desc: A story of a husband and wife who are enjoying a romantic dinner date together that ends with a tragic climax.

programme.title: Soul For Sole
programme.desc: The real essence of life is found in serving others. A regular postman, with little else in his world but his job, faithfully delivers letters throughout his challenging life. One day, an unexpected encounter offers him a new purpose to live

programme.title: The Moment
programme.desc: One evening, Dhirendra (40 yrs.) is eager to head home, yet the taxi driver is awaiting additional passengers. Eventually, a lone passenger arrives, prompting the taxi to proceed. As the driver requests fares and mentions a lack of change, a comedic spectacle ensues between the passengers and the driver. Ultimately, the narrative takes a humorous twist, concluding with a happy ending.

programme.title: U Equals To Me
programme.desc: Nikita and Neeraj know each other well, but their relationship feels awkward. Nikita finds Neeraj's touches repulsive. Aniket has proposed, but she can't let go of Neeraj. Why does she seem stuck between a rock and a hard place? What’s the matter with Neeraj? Is it some deficiency, disability or a disease? It would need a silver bullet to get them together. What if the silver bullet already exists, unknown to them?

programme.title: Tall Girlfriend Dates Short Guy
programme.desc: In this charming comedy, a couple navigates the ups and downs of their relationship, with him being shorter and her towering over him. From playful teasing by the maid to awkward encounters, his height becomes a source of humor and occasional frustration. However, amidst the laughs and challenges, her unwavering love reassures him that their bond transcends any physical differences. Join them on a delightful journey of love and laughter, where acceptance triumphs over insecurities.

programme.title: The Red Suitcase
programme.desc: A lone taxi driver’s quiet routine is shattered when she picks up a seemingly innocent passenger carrying a RED suitcase. What begins as a simple ride turns into a twisted journey, as the driver uncovers chilling clues hidden inside the suitcase that lead her into the dark mystery. She must navigate the gritty streets and her growing paranoia to survive a night that will change everything.

programme.title: Unfinished Business
programme.desc: A mother’s unwavering love gives her child the strength to face fears, embrace courage, and discover the true meaning of freedom. This inspiring tale celebrates the power of love, resilience, and the journey toward self-discovery.

programme.title: Wazir
programme.desc: A crime thriller that showcases the tale of an impeccably executed murder, where the culprits cleverly evade justice through meticulous planning and a lack of incriminating evidence.

programme.title: Taashe
programme.desc: Shiv Kothari, a village boy of 8 years is not at all interested to learn taashe (a musical instrument ), his family, and his ancestral business. What changes him so suddenly that he becomes keen to learn taashe. Who changes him so much that he decides to play taashe professionally. Watch a unique love and marriage story of two kids

programme.title: Vinyamswaha
programme.desc: You will take me for a ride in the sky, Vinay, when you become a pilot." These words have haunted Vinay throughout his life like a fearful shadow. Born into a Brahmin family, Vinay fell in love with a Valmiki girl. However, representatives of the caste-driven society, cloaked in prejudice, turned his love into a vile and grotesque joke. Today, Vinay is serving a life sentence for the rape and murder of his own girlfriend.

programme.title: Ravan Chhaya
programme.desc: Ravan-Chhaya" is a poignant short film that delves into the struggle to preserve Indian culture and traditions amidst the relentless tide of Western influence and modernization. Set in the culturally rich state of Odisha, the story revolves around the fading art form of Ravan-Chhaya, a traditional shadow puppetry style that once thrived in the region but is now on the brink of extinction.

programme.title: Thanks Mom
programme.desc: Thanks Mom is a human & a universal story of every mother & son that will melt your hearts away. The film's strength is its emotional value and connectivity to the viewers. It is the most honest & truest form of interpretation of a mother's role. It highlights a mom-son connection that is frayed and rough around the edges, filled with awkward silences and unsaid feelings that both find difficult to navigate but come around for each other when the time comes.

programme.title: Zindagi Ek Kashmakash
programme.desc: Zindagi Ek Kashmakash is a heart-wrenching story of a single mother, Rani, who has been abandoned by his boyfriend. Rani makes a living as a prostitute to support her only son, Ajay. Despite the harsh reality of her life, Rani is determined to provide a better future for Ajay. As Ajay grows older, he begins to worry that something is not quite right with his mother's job.

programme.title: Uljhan
programme.desc: After an unresolved breakup, Kartik and Ishita reunite for one last conversation. As memories resurface, so do the feelings. But closure doesn’t always mean getting back together. Uljhan is a tender tale of emotional maturity, heartbreak, and growth.

programme.title: Parinay
programme.desc: The narrative explores our thought processes, whose opinions we value, and how we handle a common issue faced by many couples: when a minor disagreement escalates into a pointless argument.

programme.title: The Apple
programme.desc: Story of two kids and how their life coincides whilst exchanging an Apple. The story reflects the societal dichotomy under the same sky in a small town near Delhi. The film is Accredited in the British Council Global Film directory and quoted by BBC as an "absolutely brilliant thought-provoking film.

programme.title: The Last Act
programme.desc: "THE LAST ACT" follows Chitra, a method actor known for her ability to fully immerse herself into any role. However, as she prepares for her latest performance, she begins to lose touch with reality, seamlessly transitioning between characters and struggling to discern where her performances end and her true self begins.

programme.title: Uyire
programme.desc: 'Uyire' explores the feeling of Love & how differently it is perceived from its actual implied meaning, whilst being a social commentary on the class system that is habitually rooted in Urban cities. Indrajit & Zoya, two contrasting individuals try to find a space where both of them feel respected. The film explores how an individual's upbringing, background, class, responsibilities, shapes their mindset, which ultimately leave Indrajit & Zoya at a stage of uncertainty.

programme.title: The Perception
programme.desc: This story follows the journey of a professional photographer and a poor cycle rickshaw driver in Mumbai at the end of spring. Through various incidents on the road, their perceptions of each other change, highlighting the contrast between their social statuses. Ultimately, their experiences weave together to create a beautiful narrative of understanding and connection.

programme.title: Prowl
programme.desc: A young girl pays a visit to a mysterious stranger after connecting with him through a dating site. What follows is either a cautionary tale or a parable, based on how you view it.

programme.title: Woh Khaas
programme.desc: A business tycoon bored with his monotonous work-life escapes from his corporate setup for a day and ends up meeting a girl, who like a dream changes him upside down in a real ‘Filmy Manner’. Woh Khaas is a jazzy tribute to Bollywood romances that tries to combine the reality of love and the flamboyance of Indian cinema in an entertaining and enriching way.

programme.title: Trp
programme.desc: A victims father tries to get justice for his daughter despite the failed situation system in place.

programme.title: Uljhe Ho Kyun
programme.desc: Fitness influencer Abhay’s quirky habit of messaging his first likes leads him to Srishti, a corporate workaholic. As sparks fly, their contrasting worlds collide in a playful yet unpredictable romance. Will their chemistry sizzle or turn to ashes? A fun, fiery take on modern love.

programme.title: Writer
programme.desc: A quiet evening between a writer and his wife unravels into a surreal exploration of love, memory, and hidden truths. As reality shifts, so do the stories they’ve been telling themselves—and each other.

programme.title: The Decision
programme.desc: The Struggle of a Female Actress in the Film Industry: A young woman faces difficulties when working with a demanding director who creates a stressful environment. She expresses her concerns to the producer, but he reacts angrily and uses harsh language toward her. Will the actress decide to find a way to work together or stand up for herself?

programme.title: Humraz
programme.desc: This is the story of a couple who tried to raise their voice against the undesirable practice of one community. Hamraz is a witness to the hero playing Ravanahatha and the incidents that happened to him... Sometimes the image that looks white is also black... Humraz is a story full of mysteries... The curtain will soon fall on all the secrets and the real story will come out in front of everyone..

programme.title: Swad Anusar
programme.desc: A rich businessman loses his memory after a blow to the head but returns home alive after being thought dead. His family doesn't believe him and he realizes they may have conspired to kill him. He dies after eating poisoned food his wife prepared. His family admits their plot, but he will return with greater vengeance.

programme.title: The Footage
programme.desc: A spy dies in an elevator leaving a message on the CCTV footage. A lip-reader is called to find out what he said

programme.title: Two Strangers
programme.desc: This narrative revolves around a man with a scientific background, unwaveringly devoted to science and sceptical of miracles. He’s dealing with a mysterious health condition, leaving every doctor surprised. It’s like a puzzle and everyone around him is clueless about it. In a surprising twist, destiny intervenes to miraculously resolve his health issue, and he remains oblivious to this extraordinary turn of events, adding a layer of intrigue to the unfolding narrative.

programme.title: The Unsent Letter
programme.desc: Nidhi is haunted by her past; she's caged in it when suddenly she gets interrupted by a waiter asking for her order. After she pulls herself together, she realizes that the waiter had called her by her name. Nidhi finds out that the waiter is a man from her past. She is now left with a choice to face her nightmare and finally let go of everything that has haunted her till now or to continue living her life in a cage.

programme.title: The Please Book
programme.desc: Dora is a small girl from a rich family who lives with her father, a busy businessman. Due to his busy schedule, he is unable to spend quality time with her. Dora is very lonely and she does not have any friends. Her loneliness ends when one day she finds an old diary with “The Please Book” written on its cover. Soon she discovers it’s not an ordinary diary but a magical book. She believes that whatever you write in The Please Book, comes true.

programme.title: Yaantrik
programme.desc: Siddharth is a novelist. He is known for his different types of writing patterns. He always talks to his soul for some creative suggestions. Now he wants to write about a character called "Yaantrik". Siddharth wants to write a book on Yaantrik but this time as an experiment he wants to become a Yaantrik and then write a book. He will follow the routine of Yaantrik. His inner soul is not convinced with this idea. After being blocked in his own idea how his inner soul helped him out is the film.

programme.title: Tohfa
programme.desc: A gentleman bestowed upon his cherished wife an incredibly valuable and heartwarming present, yet fate had a different plan in store for their journey.

programme.title: Vansh
programme.desc: Dive into the powerful narrative of Vansh, a heartfelt short film from Vidyarthi Studios & Pocket Films, that explores the societal pressures surrounding gender expectations. This gripping tale follows a father's fierce desire for a son over his beloved daughter, shedding light on deep-seated beliefs and cultural traditions. As he grapples with his emotions, this poignant story opens a discussion about love, acceptance, and true parenthood. Don’t miss this eye-opening film that promises to challenge perceptions and evoke empathy.

programme.title: Love Range
programme.desc: In the bustling metro city of Mumbai, Ayush and Roohi's lives are turned upside down by the COVID-19 pandemic. When Ayush loses his job, Roohi decides to start a tiffin service to support the family, but Raj's traditional views and wounded ego create tension as he struggles with the idea of his wife being the breadwinner.

programme.title: Suta
programme.desc: Suta (The Daughter) is the story of a bold and smart daughter who fights for the sacrifices of her mother which went unnoticed in the family. She emerges victorious and sees that her mother gains back her confidence.

programme.title: Catharsis
programme.desc: A poignant journey of a man forced onto a path of self-discovery, exploring the depths of the human mind and spirit.

programme.title: Threes A Couple
programme.desc: 3 Lives Change after they cross each other's path on one auspicious night.

programme.title: Tithlee
programme.desc: Yamini, newly married, is getting ready to meet her mother-in-law, Reema's, friends and family. Reema suggests that Yamini should appear more presentable at the party and implies a preference for fair skin. Both Yamini and Reema's son, Ankush, want to challenge this prejudice, but they have different approaches.

programme.title: Kahwa
programme.desc: Set in July 2016, in the kashmir valley, post the encounter of militant Burhan Wadi, a period that had resulted in the loss of almost 70 lives and injured over 11000 people. A young CRPF official called Surkhab is sent to kashmir as a part of his very first posting along with a few other officers in the very first week of this curfew. Although he so posted in a small base where the clashes were not seen, yet he senses a feeling of fear and tense throughout. Surkhab who is very proud & committed army officer and at the same time mesmerised by the beauty of the valley and often wonders why a place so beautiful feels like a war zone. He arrives in the area and is assigned to maintain peace during the volatile period. He is determined to do his job with utmost sincerity and discipline. During one of his rounds, Surkhab meets Shaukhat, a tea seller, who is initially reluctant to interact with him due to the ongoing tensions. However, Surkhab insists on having a cup of tea with him, and slowly, they start talking about their lives and experiences. Shaukat has a grandson who loves to play cricket but is snatched the freedom of doing so due to the curfew. He gets together with some of his adult friends and they often secretly play gully cricket. As the curfew continues, Surkhab and Shaukat's bond grows stronger, and they discuss the unrest in the neighborhood, their families, and their dreams for a peaceful future. Despite their initial differences, Surkhab and Shaukhat find a common ground of acceptance and understanding over their shared cups of tea.However, this new found equation is put to the test when an unexpected event takes place, forcing them to confront their beliefs and loyalties. Kahwa is a story of how two individuals from vastly different backgrounds and ideologies can come together and form a bond of acceptance and empathy, even in the face of adversity.

programme.title: Vishaad
programme.desc: When a weary inspector is drawn to a reclusive scientist’s house on the edge of a quiet town, his investigation takes an unexpected turn. What begins as a routine inquiry slowly unfolds into an encounter with memory itself where loss finds an intangible resonance, and silence begins to speak. Vishaad is a lyrical meditation on grief, time, and the fragile human desire to regurgitate all that the heart has tried to bury.

programme.title: Blurred Lines
programme.desc: 24-year-old Apoorva is caught in a tangle of relationships when she has an epiphany that she is attracted to her best friend who has come to dress her up to meet prospective in laws.

programme.title: Karjdar Bhola
programme.desc: In a small village, Bhola and Komal, a struggling couple, face financial hardships. Bhola, a simple laborer, and Komal, his smart and beautiful wife, are burdened by a loan from Seth ji, a corrupt man who harasses Komal. Bhola mistakenly believes Komal is involved with Seth ji, leading to a deep misunderstanding. Eventually, the truth comes to light, allowing them to overcome their challenges and find happiness together.

programme.title: Bindu
programme.desc: Bindu, a little school-going girl, and his older brother Gaurav live in the hilly regions where they barely make their day’s end meet. Gaurav works in the early shifts as a paperman, delivering news on his cycle, and finds time in between for Bindu to take her to school. A stitched-up overused shoe, an old ragged school bag, Bindu becomes the epitome of being a struggling unprivileged kid while Gaurav holds on to his pair of old sandals, the same pair of dress, and an old cycle.

programme.title: Certitude
programme.desc: This movie shows the story of Arjun, a smalltown boy from Dehradun who decides to move to Mumbai for his further studies. So in his new surroundings, he is unable to trust anyone until he finds someone whom he can finally rely on throughout his journey in Mumbai.

programme.title: Broken Stars
programme.desc: An astrologer who has a fake beard is just like his profession. He is confused about the stars and how it determines anyone's future, he tricks people daily but He is worried about his daughter suffering from a disease, then one day as it happens his past somehow connects with his present which determines his future. it is a philosophical journey of a man who constantly questions the existence of sheer weirdness of the whole connection of our stars with lives and his realization

programme.title: Betu
programme.desc: Sparsh(12), or Betu, as his mother calls him, is a happy, mischievous boy, who hates milk, who is conscious about his hairstyle and who is too impatient to wait for the lunch hour to eat his best friends tiffin. Sparsh’s life changes when his best friend’s mother dies in an accident. That being his first direct exposure to death, it shakes him up. The unpredictability of life hits him and his mind inadvertently goes to his own mother, who he realizes is not immune from the fickle composition of life. The fear of separation takes away the nonchalance from his attitude and he is no longer the carefree boy he used to be. He starts observing and watching over his mother like a guardian. As he prepares to meet the reality, he is summoned at the destination where his fears lie.

programme.title: Bharam
programme.desc: A Hindi drama short film about an executive visiting a house to give away a Mercedes won by a housewife in a lucky draw and the confusion that follows.

programme.title: Calling Bell
programme.desc: A psychopath Biriyani Delivery boy barges into the house of a young lady and threatens to kill her. The story revolves around this confrontation between these two characters. The climax of the story turns out to be something very unexpected.

programme.title: The Visit
programme.desc: "A young woman returns home after a prolonged absence, enjoying a warm bond with her mother but strained ties with her father. Reconnecting with a previously misjudged acquaintance, she faces revived conflicts with her mother. Tasked with overseeing tuition students, an unforeseen incident alters their lives permanently. Her homecoming: a blessing or a curse?"

programme.title: Barking Bruno
programme.desc: Barking Bruno sheds light on the reality of modern life, where we often prefer pets over parents, viewing them as burdens. Rohit, content with his dog Bruno, contrasts sharply with his treatment of his father, Mr. Mehra, who feels neglected. However, when Mr. Mehra meets Bruno, his life takes an unexpected turn, albeit temporarily

programme.title: Choices
programme.desc: Ritesh and Yami are just a day away from their marriage, and ritesh makes a confession which may affect their upcoming relationship, or maybe not?

programme.title: Chashmadeed
programme.desc: A 60 YO woman lives with her entitled 30-year-old son and his wife. She is a doting mother to him, and like any mother, thinks of her son as ideal. One morning, she starts having a strange issue with her eyes, as her vision keeps getting blurred in erratic spasms, like a camera going out of focus and back. Upon the recommendation of her 23-year-old hip and woke neighbor, she sets out to visit an eye clinic by herself. The solution offered at this eye clinic more than clears her blurry vision.

programme.title: Bed Tea
programme.desc: Anything can Happen Over a Bed Tea. An unexpected tale of a Rainy Morning which asks a question on a long time going on the existence of hidden evil behavior in relationships.

programme.title: Bepar
programme.desc: A flourishing young Indian immigrant, happily married to a caring Pakistani husband, appears to lead a flawless life. However, the challenges of being in an interfaith marriage and adjusting to a foreign society might prove overwhelming.

programme.title: Bita Hua Pal
programme.desc: The film delves into the universal question of love and compatibility. It follows the journey of a woman named Mira, who, like many others, finds herself questioning the foundation of her relationship. As she navigates the ups and downs of her own love story, she reflects on the nature of love and the challenges of maintaining a lasting connection.

programme.title: Bhagwaan - The Faith
programme.desc: A final chance meeting with a mysterious old homeless man changes everything they’ve experienced that day. The story delves into how deep their faith truly is and how people worship gods. Some use faith and god as a means of solace while others as a crutch for a troubling life.

programme.title: Bully
programme.desc: In This Psychological Thriller, A girl who is holding her brother hostage must confront the darker aspects of her life and come face to face with the truth.

programme.title: Best Friend
programme.desc: This story centers on Manav, a wealthy and aggressive man, who is deeply possessive of his girlfriend, Shreya. When Shreya, alone at home, invites Manav over for the first time, a misunderstanding between her and Manav's best friend leads Manav, in a fit of rage, to murder both Shreya and his guard.

programme.title: Chaar Pandrah
programme.desc: A suspense film about a military guy meeting a Stanger at the bus stop who asks him to stay at his house for the night, as he has a wrong ticket and his house is very far. But he starts to have strange feeling about the strangers wife.

programme.title: Beshak
programme.desc: Story of a couple where the wife couldn’t find the difference between dream and reality and doubt enters into the relationship!

programme.title: Black Coffee
programme.desc: Film director Tara uncovers her sister Vanya's betrayal in a relationship and decides to take dramatic action. In a jaw-dropping twist, Tara stages their deaths in a short film. The lines between fiction and reality blur as Tara invites her real sister for coffee after the shoot, leaving the audience questioning what is real.

programme.title: Beyond Failing
programme.desc: This film captures intricate nuances of student stress, competition the so called rat race, parent child relation and purposeless living vs. purposeful living.

programme.title: Blame Game
programme.desc: A woman sits alone on a beach, lost in thought, until a stranger joins her, sparking a conversation that reveals a story about love, relationships, and the bitterness they can sometimes bring. She describes a once-loving bond that, over time, turned painful, leaving lasting scars.

programme.title: Bridge
programme.desc: Mukesh is a widower and has a 28-year-old so Rahul. They live together and rarely talk amicably with each other. Rahul thinks his father is too weird for his age whereas Mukesh thinks why Rahul constantly judges him for his choices.

programme.title: Ticket Please
programme.desc: Manohar Kadam, a voluntary retired man, tries hard to establish a meaningful connection with his only son Aditya but fails. Later he follows his friend Professor's advice and tries to connect with his son through a smartphone. The short film follows the Journey of Father and Son relationship in this Digital Era.

programme.title: Chand Saanse
programme.desc: Here is a story of a woman, NAYAN, She is in the waiting room of a hospital where her father-in-law is admitted. In the waiting room she sees suffering of other people. It looks the waiting room is meant waiting for death. She meets an old man who has just lost his wife but he is not aware of it. He keeps on talking about his wife as if she is still alive. That makes NAYAN to ask a question. What is the difference between life and death? Knowing about it or being unaware about it?

programme.title: Bumbhaiyya
programme.desc: The movie shows that how a common man is affected by the inter-religious conflicts that happen and how in the end he understands the real truth.

programme.title: Countless
programme.desc: A man who decides to spend the night with a woman ends up spending countless nights with the same woman at the same time. Could this be punctuality, love, lust, or something completely different?

programme.title: Believer
programme.desc: The story revolves around a young man who is struggling with his career and has to face tough situations on the financial front. In a state of dejection/ despair he has a dialogue with his inner self. His negative self talks him into addictions and resorting to drugs or committin suicide (escapist attitude) He usually feels at home in the company of his negative self and seeks solace here. Yet somewhere he is dissatisfied and constantly looking for his positive self, whom he has only abandoned

programme.title: Bena
programme.desc: After a set of jewelry goes missing, the police search Bena's bag. Her employers, Bhai and Bhabhi, are shocked to see the contents. They throw her out and Bena spends the day calling people for jobs. The family driver calls Bena and informs her that the set was found. Bena knew that the set would be found as it was misplaced not stolen. Next, she gets a call for a new job. Bena finds out that her employer Bhabhi had recommended Bena. Why was Bena thrown out of her job? What in the bag?

programme.title: Cheater
programme.desc: Love is blind, they say. And, sometimes, quite literally! How many of us are guilty of forgiving our partners once too often for their hurtful actions? When it comes to a cheating spouse, however, you would think there was no scope for forgiveness.

programme.title: Chashmishq
programme.desc: A tale of two budding lovers, their glasses, and the unforeseen challenges that come between their first kiss.

programme.title: Budhwaar
programme.desc: In this captivating story, a man residing in a village embarks on a journey to purchase a piece of land within his community, seeking assistance from the sarpanch. Despite his wife and the sarpanch's warnings against buying the land on Budhwaar (Wednesday) due to its inauspicious nature, the man disregards their concerns and proceeds with the purchase. Filled with joy, he begins digging the land with aspirations of cultivating vegetables. However, his enthusiasm is short-lived as he soon discovers the land's infertility. His dreams are shattered as the realization dawns upon him that he has fallen victim to a deceitful scheme. What he decides to do next is a must-see, making this story all the more intriguing.

programme.title: Bandage
programme.desc: A young-adult, aspiring boxer, Aditya, trains with his father to become the best. However, he starts questioning his ambition and skills to make it to the top. Battling with his own troubles, the father tries to motivate Aditya. Will the father-son duo emerge victoriously, or will they crumble down in the face of their adversities?

programme.title: Cratch
programme.desc: When two individuals coming from two different parts of society with completely distinctive thought processes COLLIDE there would be Chaos, Confusion & a lot of disagreement, but would there ever be an eye-opening conversation? Watch this short to find out Kamrul's unique take on Life and how it affects Manay's perception towards it.

programme.title: Bhool
programme.desc: A young actor in dire straits assumes the identity of a retired Army Officer's son in real life to leverage his housing arrangement. The officer, battling memory loss, eventually uncovers the harsh reality about his long-lost son, prompting the actor to flee for his life.

programme.title: Cheers
programme.desc: We all have a fantastic life but we spoil it with our silly ideas of how to live it. This story is about how in trying to define a relationship, we actually end up confining it. One such definition is marriage and this is what is discussed in Cheers by two intimately close friends - one of whom is helping the other decide against a bad marriage that she has chosen to live with for some time now, thus stifling herself from all the happiness she is entitled to. While the intent of the friend seem questionable, the story is about why she trusts him more than anyone else with this issue that she is facing

programme.title: Blowback
programme.desc: An anxious boy is confused if marijuana helps him with his issues. His quest to answer this dilemma leads him into a night full of corruption and deceit.

programme.title: Charitra Varnan
programme.desc: A cab driver comes across a woman standing and crying along the roadside. He tries to help her and tells her that he would drop her home safely. What happens next will leave you stunned.

programme.title: Divorce Celebration
programme.desc: While staging a sarcastic pre-divorce photoshoot, a couple is forced to confront the memories and emotions that prove their love isn’t as over as they thought.

programme.title: Prem Patra
programme.desc: In 1970s India, Sakshi, a curious college girl, stumbles upon a hidden envelope under a garden bench while searching for a dropped coin. Inside is a nameless, heartfelt love letter. Drawn in by its mystery, Sakshi returns the next day—only to find a new letter, this time from the lover’s other half. What begins as a fleeting curiosity becomes a quiet obsession, as Sakshi discovers an untold romance between two people separated by caste and family expectations. When their letter exchange abruptly ends, Sakshi, desperate to see love triumph, writes a reply pretending to be the man. But the woman senses the lie—his scent is missing—and in heartbreak, tears the letter away. Left in disappointment, Sakshi returns once more—only to find a young man with a plastered leg searching under the same bench. Is he the one from the letters? Or just another coincidence?

programme.title: Blurred Lines
programme.desc: 24-year-old Apoorva is caught in a tangle of relationships when she has an epiphany that she is attracted to her best friend who has come to dress her up to meet prospective in laws.

programme.desc: A Hindi drama short film about an executive visiting a house to give away a Mercedes won by a housewife in a lucky draw and the confusion that follows.

programme.title: Calling Bell
programme.desc: A psychopath Biriyani Delivery boy barges into the house of a young lady and threatens to kill her. The story revolves around this confrontation between these two characters. The climax of the story turns out to be something very unexpected.

programme.title: The Visit
programme.desc: "A young woman returns home after a prolonged absence, enjoying a warm bond with her mother but strained ties with her father. Reconnecting with a previously misjudged acquaintance, she faces revived conflicts with her mother. Tasked with overseeing tuition students, an unforeseen incident alters their lives permanently. Her homecoming: a blessing or a curse?"

programme.title: Barking Bruno
programme.desc: Barking Bruno sheds light on the reality of modern life, where we often prefer pets over parents, viewing them as burdens. Rohit, content with his dog Bruno, contrasts sharply with his treatment of his father, Mr. Mehra, who feels neglected. However, when Mr. Mehra meets Bruno, his life takes an unexpected turn, albeit temporarily

programme.title: Choices
programme.desc: Ritesh and Yami are just a day away from their marriage, and ritesh makes a confession which may affect their upcoming relationship, or maybe not?

programme.title: Chashmadeed
programme.desc: A 60 YO woman lives with her entitled 30-year-old son and his wife. She is a doting mother to him, and like any mother, thinks of her son as ideal. One morning, she starts having a strange issue with her eyes, as her vision keeps getting blurred in erratic spasms, like a camera going out of focus and back. Upon the recommendation of her 23-year-old hip and woke neighbor, she sets out to visit an eye clinic by herself. The solution offered at this eye clinic more than clears her blurry vision.

programme.title: Bed Tea
programme.desc: Anything can Happen Over a Bed Tea. An unexpected tale of a Rainy Morning which asks a question on a long time going on the existence of hidden evil behavior in relationships.

programme.title: Bepar
programme.desc: A flourishing young Indian immigrant, happily married to a caring Pakistani husband, appears to lead a flawless life. However, the challenges of being in an interfaith marriage and adjusting to a foreign society might prove overwhelming.

programme.title: Bita Hua Pal
programme.desc: The film delves into the universal question of love and compatibility. It follows the journey of a woman named Mira, who, like many others, finds herself questioning the foundation of her relationship. As she navigates the ups and downs of her own love story, she reflects on the nature of love and the challenges of maintaining a lasting connection.

programme.title: Bhagwaan - The Faith
programme.desc: A final chance meeting with a mysterious old homeless man changes everything they’ve experienced that day. The story delves into how deep their faith truly is and how people worship gods. Some use faith and god as a means of solace while others as a crutch for a troubling life.

programme.title: Bully
programme.desc: In This Psychological Thriller, A girl who is holding her brother hostage must confront the darker aspects of her life and come face to face with the truth.

programme.title: Best Friend
programme.desc: This story centers on Manav, a wealthy and aggressive man, who is deeply possessive of his girlfriend, Shreya. When Shreya, alone at home, invites Manav over for the first time, a misunderstanding between her and Manav's best friend leads Manav, in a fit of rage, to murder both Shreya and his guard.

programme.title: Chaar Pandrah
programme.desc: A suspense film about a military guy meeting a Stanger at the bus stop who asks him to stay at his house for the night, as he has a wrong ticket and his house is very far. But he starts to have strange feeling about the strangers wife.

programme.title: Beshak
programme.desc: Story of a couple where the wife couldn’t find the difference between dream and reality and doubt enters into the relationship!

programme.title: Black Coffee
programme.desc: Film director Tara uncovers her sister Vanya's betrayal in a relationship and decides to take dramatic action. In a jaw-dropping twist, Tara stages their deaths in a short film. The lines between fiction and reality blur as Tara invites her real sister for coffee after the shoot, leaving the audience questioning what is real.

programme.title: Beyond Failing
programme.desc: This film captures intricate nuances of student stress, competition the so called rat race, parent child relation and purposeless living vs. purposeful living.

programme.title: Blame Game
programme.desc: A woman sits alone on a beach, lost in thought, until a stranger joins her, sparking a conversation that reveals a story about love, relationships, and the bitterness they can sometimes bring. She describes a once-loving bond that, over time, turned painful, leaving lasting scars.

programme.title: Bridge
programme.desc: Mukesh is a widower and has a 28-year-old so Rahul. They live together and rarely talk amicably with each other. Rahul thinks his father is too weird for his age whereas Mukesh thinks why Rahul constantly judges him for his choices.

programme.title: Ticket Please
programme.desc: Manohar Kadam, a voluntary retired man, tries hard to establish a meaningful connection with his only son Aditya but fails. Later he follows his friend Professor's advice and tries to connect with his son through a smartphone. The short film follows the Journey of Father and Son relationship in this Digital Era.

programme.title: Chand Saanse
programme.desc: Here is a story of a woman, NAYAN, She is in the waiting room of a hospital where her father-in-law is admitted. In the waiting room she sees suffering of other people. It looks the waiting room is meant waiting for death. She meets an old man who has just lost his wife but he is not aware of it. He keeps on talking about his wife as if she is still alive. That makes NAYAN to ask a question. What is the difference between life and death? Knowing about it or being unaware about it?

programme.title: Bumbhaiyya
programme.desc: The movie shows that how a common man is affected by the inter-religious conflicts that happen and how in the end he understands the real truth.

programme.title: Countless
programme.desc: A man who decides to spend the night with a woman ends up spending countless nights with the same woman at the same time. Could this be punctuality, love, lust, or something completely different?

programme.title: Believer
programme.desc: The story revolves around a young man who is struggling with his career and has to face tough situations on the financial front. In a state of dejection/ despair he has a dialogue with his inner self. His negative self talks him into addictions and resorting to drugs or committin suicide (escapist attitude) He usually feels at home in the company of his negative self and seeks solace here. Yet somewhere he is dissatisfied and constantly looking for his positive self, whom he has only abandoned

programme.title: Bena
programme.desc: After a set of jewelry goes missing, the police search Bena's bag. Her employers, Bhai and Bhabhi, are shocked to see the contents. They throw her out and Bena spends the day calling people for jobs. The family driver calls Bena and informs her that the set was found. Bena knew that the set would be found as it was misplaced not stolen. Next, she gets a call for a new job. Bena finds out that her employer Bhabhi had recommended Bena. Why was Bena thrown out of her job? What in the bag?

programme.title: Cheater
programme.desc: Love is blind, they say. And, sometimes, quite literally! How many of us are guilty of forgiving our partners once too often for their hurtful actions? When it comes to a cheating spouse, however, you would think there was no scope for forgiveness.

programme.title: Chashmishq
programme.desc: A tale of two budding lovers, their glasses, and the unforeseen challenges that come between their first kiss.

programme.title: Budhwaar
programme.desc: In this captivating story, a man residing in a village embarks on a journey to purchase a piece of land within his community, seeking assistance from the sarpanch. Despite his wife and the sarpanch's warnings against buying the land on Budhwaar (Wednesday) due to its inauspicious nature, the man disregards their concerns and proceeds with the purchase. Filled with joy, he begins digging the land with aspirations of cultivating vegetables. However, his enthusiasm is short-lived as he soon discovers the land's infertility. His dreams are shattered as the realization dawns upon him that he has fallen victim to a deceitful scheme. What he decides to do next is a must-see, making this story all the more intriguing.

programme.title: Bandage
programme.desc: A young-adult, aspiring boxer, Aditya, trains with his father to become the best. However, he starts questioning his ambition and skills to make it to the top. Battling with his own troubles, the father tries to motivate Aditya. Will the father-son duo emerge victoriously, or will they crumble down in the face of their adversities?

programme.title: Cratch
programme.desc: When two individuals coming from two different parts of society with completely distinctive thought processes COLLIDE there would be Chaos, Confusion & a lot of disagreement, but would there ever be an eye-opening conversation? Watch this short to find out Kamrul's unique take on Life and how it affects Manay's perception towards it.

programme.title: Bhool
programme.desc: A young actor in dire straits assumes the identity of a retired Army Officer's son in real life to leverage his housing arrangement. The officer, battling memory loss, eventually uncovers the harsh reality about his long-lost son, prompting the actor to flee for his life.

programme.title: Cheers
programme.desc: We all have a fantastic life but we spoil it with our silly ideas of how to live it. This story is about how in trying to define a relationship, we actually end up confining it. One such definition is marriage and this is what is discussed in Cheers by two intimately close friends - one of whom is helping the other decide against a bad marriage that she has chosen to live with for some time now, thus stifling herself from all the happiness she is entitled to. While the intent of the friend seem questionable, the story is about why she trusts him more than anyone else with this issue that she is facing

programme.title: Blowback
programme.desc: An anxious boy is confused if marijuana helps him with his issues. His quest to answer this dilemma leads him into a night full of corruption and deceit.

programme.title: Charitra Varnan
programme.desc: A cab driver comes across a woman standing and crying along the roadside. He tries to help her and tells her that he would drop her home safely. What happens next will leave you stunned.

programme.title: Divorce Celebration
programme.desc: While staging a sarcastic pre-divorce photoshoot, a couple is forced to confront the memories and emotions that prove their love isn’t as over as they thought.

programme.title: Prem Patra
programme.desc: In 1970s India, Sakshi, a curious college girl, stumbles upon a hidden envelope under a garden bench while searching for a dropped coin. Inside is a nameless, heartfelt love letter. Drawn in by its mystery, Sakshi returns the next day—only to find a new letter, this time from the lover’s other half. What begins as a fleeting curiosity becomes a quiet obsession, as Sakshi discovers an untold romance between two people separated by caste and family expectations. When their letter exchange abruptly ends, Sakshi, desperate to see love triumph, writes a reply pretending to be the man. But the woman senses the lie—his scent is missing—and in heartbreak, tears the letter away. Left in disappointment, Sakshi returns once more—only to find a young man with a plastered leg searching under the same bench. Is he the one from the letters? Or just another coincidence?

programme.title: Happily Married Part 2
programme.desc: Rani & Animesh, a couple who is having an affair with Jimmy plan to meet him on Saturday. The story unfolds as their meeting with Jimmy doesn’t go as planned.

programme.title: Half Cake
programme.desc: HALF CAKE is about a single mother who struggles to earn extra wages to fulfil an innocent ask of a cake from her only son. Beyond the cake, it's a tale of innocence and resilience that will touch your heart.

programme.title: Just Take It Easy
programme.desc: The story is basically on internal happiness. Sanjay a businessman is the CEO of Oberoi Industries. He is not happy in his life. Despite having all the materialistic pleasure not happy internally. The company celebrates its success party on its high growth. Sanjay invites a model Priyanka, his girlfriend to the party. He promises her to make the face of Oberoi Industries.

programme.title: Funkaar
programme.desc: A heart-warming tale of a mother who rediscovers her passion for her craft when her daughter pushes her beyond the confines of her daily routine.

programme.title: Jama Punji
programme.desc: A late night conversation between a mother (Sarla) & her son Anshuman, 13 days after the passing of his father where they discuss the reasons for his detachment with his father and how by the end of the night, certain events lead Anshuman to accept and make amends with his deceased father.

programme.title: Harela
programme.desc: A 60-year-old woman and a young man navigate tradition and modernity during the festival in Uttarakhand. Who will uphold their heritage in an evolving world?

programme.title: Harmless
programme.desc: A boy down on his luck. A girl looking for thrills. A plot is hatched. A kidnapping is staged. As far as crimes go, this one seems harmless. But, as with all things, there is a price to pay. A hefty price. Harmless begins as a crime-thriller and develops into a dramatic adventure with a little bit of romance thrown in.

programme.title: Hack-her
programme.desc: Shraddha, about to leave for America through a Corporate that is currently under attack by a hacker, who is on run by the police and is currently on every news channel. Between all this is Vishesh, who truly loves Shraddha, and now even she is going, just like his parents, leaving him all alone. But not everything we see is true, a hacker on a mission, a girl with ambitions, and a lover, sounds good right? But who is who? Do we know the entire truth? Find out everything in our upcoming short film "Hack-Her"

programme.title: Ketaki
programme.desc: At dusk in Mumbai, 22-year-old Ava hoped for a moment with her neighbor Harry, who hurried past, preoccupied. At home, Harry revealed stolen cash from a bank robbery. When Aaron demanded the money at gunpoint, Harry shot him dead. Hearing the shots, Ava discovered the scene and, confessing her love for Harry, chose to stay. They buried Aaron, symbolizing a new beginning. As they prepared to flee, Ava's past caught up with them, leading to another gunshot as they escaped, with the haunting "Behri Duniya" playing on.

programme.title: Green Screen
programme.desc: One day he find something and with the help of his friend, try to fulfill his dream. But, fate has a different game. The world of the 'Haves' and their desire for the little things in lives that eludes them and the desires invoked by Screen, which teaches us to salivate over things we never knew, otherwise existed. Sometimes small things matter the most.

programme.title: Housewarming
programme.desc: A short film signifying how the energies we invite into our house affect us.

programme.title: Harshit
programme.desc: This film is inspired by Shakespeare's Hamlet, written by Dhruva Harsh. It contains all the Shakespearean elements like, betrayal, love, hatred, revenge, sexual jealousy, poetic justice and dilemma of existence. Harshit is a protagonist synonymous to Hamlet, a Hindu boy living in a Muslim dominated area in Mumbai, India, loves Rahila, his neighbour. Later on fate plays a game in which two innocents, Harshit n Rahila are trapped.

programme.title: Pravaah The Flow
programme.desc: This story is about this Nature photographer Shivoham. Through his travel, he likes to explore and capture wonderful, breath taking creations of nature and places. But how can a journey be complete, without interesting escapades? 5 different locations, 5 different interactions revealing the darkest secrets, depth of life, deep hidden emotions and finally, ending the journey with an experience that leaves him all rejuvenated…as if he had a new birth and gets him all set for the next one.

programme.title: Gutargu
programme.desc: Gutargu is a romantic Hindi short story about a guy a girl who admire each other, and are falling for each other secretly. Their unusual love story takes place on a rooftop. Will their love story have a happy ending?

programme.title: Horror Chapters
programme.desc: Many horror events, interaction with super natural possibilities. Exploring the Paranormal

programme.title: Kamera
programme.desc: He is a 12 years old boy, who works in a garbage dump and lives in the slum along with his mother. Both have different ideologies towards life. He is a staunch believer of being positive and has a dream of spreading smiles. But, his mother is a frustrated woman. While working, he finds a digital camera in the dump. His friend tells him that people smile whenever you point it towards them. He soon realizes the same and gets all thrilled to spread smiles including his mother. Unfortunately, the camera gets lost and all his dreams get shattered. What happens next is the core of the film. The story revolves around the perception of a small kid who wants to follow his dreams.

programme.title: Hearts Awash In Sapphire Light
programme.desc: Hearts Awash in Sapphire Light unfolds the tale of two individuals who encounter each other one evening, initially under less-than-ideal circumstances. At first, they engage in petty arguments over trivial matters. However, as time passes, the undeniable power of their connection becomes evident, serving as a poignant reminder that sometimes, the most extraordinary journeys take place within the depths of our own hearts.

programme.title: Holding Back
programme.desc: Short Film Holding back a short film is based on a true incident in 1999, of Shiva, a young man suffering from blood cancer and who, unfortunately, passed away during the journey while traveling by train from Bangalore to Chennai, for a friend’s marriage. Shiva was traveling with his mom and elder cousin Suresh. This film deals with the mother’s emotional journey of her son’s death. The pivotal character- Mother, is played by the national award winner Seema Biswas, popularly known for her role in and as the Bandit Queen; while Father is played by national award-winning director-writer Ananth Mahadevan; Coolie is played by Aditya Lakhia (Kachra) of Lagaan fame; Cousin brother is played by Raj Arjun, main lead in Shabri and Kaalo, Shiva, the son is played by Kunal Kumar with supporting roles played by Marathi theatre and film veterans, Pradeep Patwardhan and Jaywanth Wadekar. Background score is to be given by Anurag Saikia, the national award winner for the music of Yugadrashta in 2014. The camerawork is done by Pushpank Gawade who won the best award for Cinematography for the film Kaalo in South Africa film festival 2012.

programme.title: Hum Types
programme.desc: Charu, a girl from high society, faces her own struggles. One night, she meets Makrand, a boy from a low social class. Initially, their class difference creates a barrier, but as they spend time together, Charu realizes they share more similarities than differences. Through moments of vulnerability and connection, they discover their common humanity.

programme.title: Girgit
programme.desc: The film is an adaptation of Anton Chekhov's short story Chameleon. It tells a cheeky tale of injustice and corruption exposing the insincerity of public officials and selfish interests that aggravate or subdue their actions.

programme.title: Kajal
programme.desc: Like all elements, humans have a saturation point. What happens when a woman a constantly bullied by her boss, harassed by strangers and abused by her husband finds an abandoned package one night? A package that holds an answer to all her demons. A package that triggers an inner change in her the moment that she lays eyes on it. Kohl captures a turning point in the life of a woman, in a world claimed by men.

programme.title: Hey Listen!
programme.desc: After a few years of their breakup, Dhruv and Vidya finally got in touch with each other and decide to meet at the same place they used to hang out. All the memories were flashed, which lead them into a huge fight mixed with a lot of emotions that were buried within them years ago, and follows into an open end to the story.

programme.title: Abnormal
programme.desc: This is the tale of a mother who grapples with societal challenges due to her transgender son. She confronts opposition from her family and the broader community, yet resolves to safeguard her child's future. Eventually, she triumphs in establishing their identity within society.

programme.title: Jale Tere Honth
programme.desc: A young couple on their first date with the excitement of their first kiss does not find a private moment in the crowded city of Mumbai. Do they finally manage to experience that magical moment?

programme.title: Humari Khushboo
programme.desc: Khushboo a beautiful, young smart girl of 24 years has a medical condition that is associated with a social taboo, and her confidence is shattered when she ruins a Project Presentation in front of a prestigious and renowned client in her office. How she regains her lost confidence and fights against a social taboo, is the sort of stance HUMARI KHUSHBOO will take.

programme.title: Ghar
programme.desc: Isaac, a 15-year-old boy, is trapped in the trauma of his parents' separation, leading him to lose his passion for music. His grandmother advises him to revisit his passion and meet Naomi, a retired singer. How he finds beauty in his brokenness, follows the crux of the story.

programme.title: Keep Punching
programme.desc: Prior to realising her dream of representing the country, withdrawn boxer Kirnay must first fight the battle for her freedom outside the ring.

programme.title: The Friend To Die For
programme.desc: Can the girl survive, despite being abducted by a mentally unstable kidnapper whom society perceives as a serial killer? The truth may reveal a different story than what is commonly believed.

programme.title: Jaane Do Mujhe
programme.desc: Nisha is enjoying her date with Aditya, who was set up by her friends. While Aditya is in the washroom, Nisha hears a loud thud and rushes to check on him. She finds Aditya lying unconscious on the floor. Nisha contacts her friend Priya to inform her about the incident. However, Priya tries to reassure Nisha that it's all in her head and there's nothing to worry about. This raises the question of whether Aditya is still alive or if he exists solely in Nisha's imagination.

programme.title: French Date
programme.desc: Promila, a beautiful but lonely woman in a busy city, frequently on internet dating sites, meets Arun who's also stricken with a singlehood status for his whole life. As they both decide to spend some casual time together one evening. French Date, at first feels like a normal romantic story, which it is, but soon the viewer realizes something is different. The short film shall keep the grey matter in your brain active and you might find yourself on the edge of your seat.

programme.title: Kartavya
programme.desc: Aditi, once carefree, transforms into a responsible caregiver when her father suffers a paralysis stroke. Her newfound maturity surprises her mother. Six months later, as her parents suggest marriage, Aditi insists on finding a partner who accepts her and her parents. Will she find such a person in today's world?

programme.title: Freedom
programme.desc: Freedom is based on the lives of three women. All of them are going through the difficult challenges, which is made by society and their own family members. Despite living in democratic society lots of women still do not have permission to follow their passion or choose their carrier.

programme.title: Fried
programme.desc: In Mumbai, newlyweds Tanya and Rajat struggle after she loses her job. As financial strain and depression take a toll, their love is tested. An emotional journey of resilience, love, and the hidden impact of corporate layoffs on relationships.

programme.title: I Am Brampton
programme.desc: A city which never receives the credit it deserves, but comforts many new immigrants, with open arms

programme.title: Juwaa
programme.desc: Tillu, a struggling villager, gambles his wife's mangalsutra for a shot at change. Against the odds, he wins—but discovers the real gamble is just beginning. A tale of hope, sacrifice, and the unexpected twists of life.

programme.title: Haseen Rahasya
programme.desc: Raj, an AI engineer, has built an AI house operator Jyoti. Raj goes on a date with Sara. Sara, a chemistry teacher already having the experience of real- world experience, is icing on the cake. Everything goes smoothly. But the fun turns into fear when Jyoti says "Run to save yourself". Sara's talk with Jyoti turns the fairytale into a nightmare. What will Sara do to save her life?

programme.title: Loha Chor
programme.desc: A modest family from Haryana relocated to Dhanbad, Bihar, and took up residence in a government quarter that had previously been inhabited by the notorious "Loha Chor" gang during the 1980s in Bihar. The family encountered numerous challenges and social difficulties from both the local neighbourhood inhabitants and the remnants of the Loha Chor gang. Subsequently, law enforcement authorities conducted a raid on the premises. Through determination and courage, both the family and the protagonist of this story effectively navigated the situation in order to resolve the issue and find a resolution.

programme.title: Inphlembul
programme.desc: When two shady transport guys bicker over how dangerous their delivery consignment could be, they end up challenging each other’s a logic, knowledge, and sense of culture and language.

programme.title: Hmm
programme.desc: It all begins at a midnight bus stop, where a girl finds herself unsettled due to a stranger boy's attempts to comfort his girlfriend over a phone call. When his efforts prove unsuccessful, he starts conversing with the girl instead. Despite her apparent reluctance to engage, the boy persists in his conversation, much like a bee unwilling to leave a flower. As the night unfolds, these two unfamiliar individuals end up walking home together. Along the way, they delve into profound discussions about love and relationships. The culmination arrives in a meticulously orchestrated surprise, adding a climactic twist to their journey.

programme.title: The Exit Interview
programme.desc: The Exit Interview is a tense psychological drama set within the confined walls of a corporate HR cabin. The film follows Tanish, an employee desperate to break free from workplace abuse, only to be cornered by a relentless HR representative who refuses to let him go. Through sharp dialogue and escalating tension, the short explores themes of gaslighting, coercion, and the invisible scars of toxic corporate culture.

programme.title: The Scooter

His friend tells him that people smile whenever you point it towards them. He soon realizes the same and gets all thrilled to spread smiles including his mother. Unfortunately, the camera gets lost and all his dreams get shattered. What happens next is the core of the film. The story revolves around the perception of a small kid who wants to follow his dreams.

programme.title: Hearts Awash In Sapphire Light
programme.desc: Hearts Awash in Sapphire Light unfolds the tale of two individuals who encounter each other one evening, initially under less-than-ideal circumstances. At first, they engage in petty arguments over trivial matters. However, as time passes, the undeniable power of their connection becomes evident, serving as a poignant reminder that sometimes, the most extraordinary journeys take place within the depths of our own hearts.

programme.title: Holding Back
programme.desc: Short Film Holding back a short film is based on a true incident in 1999, of Shiva, a young man suffering from blood cancer and who, unfortunately, passed away during the journey while traveling by train from Bangalore to Chennai, for a friend’s marriage. Shiva was traveling with his mom and elder cousin Suresh. This film deals with the mother’s emotional journey of her son’s death. The pivotal character- Mother, is played by the national award winner Seema Biswas, popularly known for her role in and as the Bandit Queen; while Father is played by national award-winning director-writer Ananth Mahadevan; Coolie is played by Aditya Lakhia (Kachra) of Lagaan fame; Cousin brother is played by Raj Arjun, main lead in Shabri and Kaalo, Shiva, the son is played by Kunal Kumar with supporting roles played by Marathi theatre and film veterans, Pradeep Patwardhan and Jaywanth Wadekar. Background score is to be given by Anurag Saikia, the national award winner for the music of Yugadrashta in 2014. The camerawork is done by Pushpank Gawade who won the best award for Cinematography for the film Kaalo in South Africa film festival 2012.

programme.title: Baal Krishna
programme.desc: the conflict between Shri Krishna and Indra, highlighting the struggle between humility and pride. When the people of Vrindavan stop worshipping Indra, he unleashes storms, fire, and earthquakes to punish them. Krishna guides the villagers to honor nature, especially Govardhan Hill, teaching that true devotion arises from love, not fear. Despite illusions and destructive rains meant to break their faith, Krishna protects everyone and restores balance. The story ultimately emphasizes faith, courage, and the triumph of righteousness over arrogance.

programme.title: Baal Krishna
programme.desc: Lord Indra’s pride leads him into conflict, but he ultimately realizes his mistake and seeks forgiveness, understanding that arrogance was his true downfall. Meanwhile, Krishna bravely enters the forbidden spirit realm to rescue his father, Nanda, who has been taken captive. Facing powerful mystical forces and illusions, Krishna remains steadfast in his duty and devotion. With guidance from sages, he discovers that sacred rites can grant liberation to trapped souls. The episode emphasizes humility, faith, and the triumph of righteousness over illusion and ego.

programme.title: Baal Krishna
programme.desc: During the Holi festival in Vrindavan, a series of curses, poisoned colors, and hidden conspiracies threaten the lives of the villagers and Radha. Shri Krishna uncovers deceptive schemes involving a deadly toxin and a famine-like curse that turns food into dust. To save everyone, he retrieves the mystical Amar Phal, whose divine fragrance removes hunger and revives hope. Meanwhile, Vishambhar’s foretold death brings a profound clash between destiny and free will, even drawing Yamaraj into the conflict. Through wisdom, sacrifice, and compassion, Krishna protects his devotees and proves that divine intelligence can uphold multiple vows without violating cosmic law.

programme.title: Baal Krishna
programme.desc: In Vrindavan, strange events unfold as Vidyadhar is revealed to be bound by an ancient curse, spreading poison and fire under hidden influence. Krishna uncovers the conspiracy, frees the cursed being, and restores balance through wisdom and compassion. Meanwhile, King Kansa is disturbed by prophetic dreams and plots to lure Krishna to Mathura through a grand contest. Destiny moves closer to an inevitable confrontation.

programme.title: Porus
programme.desc: During Alexander’s celebration, Porus and Laachi secretly rescue Barsine and escape, intending to lure Alexander toward Darius in Bactria. Alexander publicly humiliates Darius's alliance offer, proclaims himself divinely destined to rule, and tightens his grip through fear and brutality. As Porus is named emperor, conspiracies rise on both sides. Alexander’s tyranny peaks when he orders a child’s execution, prompting Porus to openly challenge him. Enraged, Alexander announces a public gladiator duel, setting tyranny against honor.

programme.title: Porus
programme.desc: Alexander humiliates Porus, demanding submission, but Porus defies him with unwavering Bharatiya values of honor, duty, and courage. Imprisoned yet secretly protecting Barsine, Porus faces a public gladiator duel, fighting unarmed and earning acclaim as''The great man, Porus'' Amid political intrigue, palace secrets, and looming battles, Porus demonstrates true valor by sparing his enemies, proving that principled strength surpasses conquest through fear.

programme.title: Porus
programme.desc: Malay escapes captivity, prompting Queen Anusuya to protect him and seek justice, while Porus defies Alexander, sparing him to defend India’s honor. Kanishk is named crown prince, sparking unrest, and Shiv Dutt plots revenge. Amid betrayal and false declarations of Prince Purushottam’s death, power struggles erupt: Shiv Dutt seizes the throne, Bamani refuses to surrender, and a manhunt begins for Purushottam, setting the stage for escalating conflict.

programme.title: Porus
programme.desc: Ambition and betrayal erupt as Kanishk, urged by Shiv Dutt, seizes the Paurav throne, imprisoning Queen Anusuya and humiliating her. Puru escapes Alexander’s forces with loyal allies, aided by Vishuddhi’s sacrifice, and races back to defend his kingdom, upholding Indian values by sparing Alexander. Meanwhile, Alexander plans his march toward India, while Bactrian leaders debate strategy and Princess Roxana urges resistance. As storms and prophecies foreshadow disaster, Anusuya vows revenge on Shiv Dutt, setting the stage for a clash of honor, vengeance, and destiny between Porus and Alexander.
